items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. AI computing uses a lot of electricity, and its effects on power systems depend on how power usage changes quickly over time. Federated Learning (FL) allows AI systems to train together without sharing raw data, but traditional FL lacks proper governance features. This paper introduces GAFL, a method that adds verification, fairness checks, and secure logging to ensure trustworthy collaboration. Finding training data in large repositories requires more than text relevance because queries include specific constraints like task and license. Big Tech companies' recent earnings reports raised concerns about increased AI spending, causing stock prices to drop.
